description: This file defines the EqualsOperator class, which implements comparison logic for 'equals' filter operations in a JSON API context within SuiteCRM. It provides methods to return filter and SQL representations and validate operators.

classes.name: EqualsOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'equals' comparison operator for filtering in SuiteCRM's JSON API implementation.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag 'eq' for use in filtering queries.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator '=' for database queries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and checks its validity via parent class method.
